card.name: Capital T starting medical terms in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter T (or t) that begins a new word after a linking word or colon, in warning headings and adverse-reaction lists. Examples are Tissue, Tendinitis, Tachycardia, Tumor, Treatment.

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: Capital T opens a word in an all-caps warning title after AND, INCLUDING, or a colon.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS ADVERSE REACTIONS INCLUDING<< T>>ENDINITIS, TENDON RU

modes.label: Body-text terms
modes.description: T starts a medical term in running text after a linking word such as in, and, or of.
modes.example: recommended as the sole agent in general anesthesia because loss of consciousness cannot be assured and because of a high incidence of apnea, muscle rigidity, and<< t>>achycardia.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter T of words like tissue, tendon, tachycardia or tumor, which come up in warning headings.
